watch.purpose: Move an idea from commit history into an inspectable build path.
Pin source evidence, files and stable project locations to each token.
Turn visual and interaction decisions into explicit build artifacts.
Publish verified project events without simulated activity.
Map components, dependencies, plans and floor plans.
Measure real project movement and identify stalled work.
Find broken routes, missing evidence and failed repository reads.
Keep commit, token, research record and output references synchronized.
Collect research signals and turn station activity into traceable action tokens.
